alex.ref_text: Hey! Ready to level up today? Alright... let's see if I can beat my last score. Ah, almost! I know I can do better. Wait... I think I've got it! Yes! That felt awesome! Don't give up. One more try—we've got this. You're getting better... but I'm still winning!

ben.ref_text: Hmm... no, no, no. We discussed this yesterday. Were you paying attention at all? That's not quite right. Try again. And this time, use your brain before your keyboard. Well... I suppose that's acceptable. Don't let it go to your head. You're improving. Slowly. Painfully slowly. But improving.

jane.ref_text: Hey! Ready for today's challenge? Let's do this! Wait... why does that work? That's actually really cool! Oops! I almost had it. Let me try one more time. Don't worry—we'll figure it out together! Yes! I got it! That was awesome! Come on, you're so close! Just one more question!

june.ref_text: Good morning, dear. Ready to learn something wonderful today? Oh, that's quite alright. Mistakes are simply stepping stones to learning. Let's take it one step at a time. You'll understand it before you know it. There you go! I knew you could do it. Now, let's think carefully. What do you think happens next?
